confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from an RBA search result: AUD/USD 0.6720 at 4pm on 18 Nov 2026. Food and coffee anchors rest on crowd-sourced price pages (Numbeo-style and Expatistan) quoted in NZD, which I converted to USD at roughly 0.59 USD per NZD. Those pages give about NZ$5.6-6.2 for a cappuccino, NZ$11-13 for a domestic beer, about NZ$25 for an inexpensive meal, and about NZ$135-165 for a three-course dinner for two. The cocktail anchor uses an Expatistan figure of about NZ$18, from only 8 price points at a downtown club, so I shaded it down slightly. I found no Wellington-specific wine price, so the wine anchor is inferred from the local beer and cocktail relationship and Auckland hotel-bar by-the-glass prices of roughly NZ$15-19. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Wellington. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect live listings. They are the least certain anchors and vary with season and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wellington is a high-cost New Zealand capital. Its restaurant prices are slightly above the New Zealand average, similar to Christchurch and a little below Canberra. Accommodation is benchmarked against other mid-sized Australasian capitals.
